class.name: TrackServer
class.brief_description: Track geometry, switches, isolated sections and the track graph, by RID.
class.description: A track is geometry: one curve, or two for a switch. A track of [constant TRACK_SWITCH] type gets a switch of its own - a RID of its own holding the branch it is set to and its blade movement (TTrack::SwitchExtension, Track.cpp) - created and freed with the type ([signal switch_created], [signal switch_freed]). The tracks' endpoints are paired into a graph ([method topology_rebuild]) that [method track_get_next] and [method track_trace_route] follow, the switches as they are set. Tracks are grouped into isolated sections whose occupancy is reported as one.

method.name: isolated_add_track
method.description: Adds [param track] to the isolated section; its axles count towards the section's occupancy (TIsolated, Track.cpp:90-170).

method.name: isolated_create
method.description: Creates an isolated section: a group of tracks whose occupancy is reported as one.

method.name: isolated_free
method.description: Frees the isolated section; its tracks stay.

method.name: isolated_get_name
method.description: Returns the name the isolated section is registered under.

method.name: isolated_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the isolated section registered under [param name], or an invalid RID when there is none.

method.name: isolated_is_occupied
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while any axle stands on a track of the section or of its child sections.

method.name: isolated_set_name
method.description: Registers the isolated section under [param name].

method.name: isolated_set_parent
method.description: Makes the section part of [param parent] (an [code]area[/code]): the parent is occupied while this section is.

method.name: switch_get_active_track
method.description: Returns the branch the switch is set to.

method.name: switch_get_f_offset1
method.description: Returns the first blade's offset [m], clamped to [member switch_max_offset] (Track.cpp:1933-1941). Read by the blade animation.

method.name: switch_get_f_offset2
method.description: Returns the second blade's offset [m], never below 0 (Track.cpp:1933-1941). Read by the blade animation.

method.name: switch_get_name
method.description: Returns the name of the switch: the name of its track.

method.name: switch_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the switch of the switch track registered under [param name], or an invalid RID when there is no such track or it is not a switch.

method.name: switch_get_track
method.description: Returns the track the switch belongs to.

method.name: switch_set_active_track
method.description: Sets the switch to [param active_track]: emits [signal switch_active_track_changed] and [signal switch_movement_started], then moves the blades at the original's speed (Track.cpp:1743-1755, 1944) and emits [signal switch_movement_finished] when they are in place - at once when they already are.

method.name: topology_get_summary
method.description: Returns statistics of the track graph: [code]graphs[/code] (id, number of tracks and switches, total length of each connected graph) and the number of orphaned tracks.

method.name: topology_rebuild
method.description: Pairs the endpoints of all tracks again and rebuilds the connected graphs; emits [signal topology_rebuilt].

method.name: track_axle_entered
method.description: Reports that an axle of [param vehicle] came onto the track - called by [RailVehicleServer] for each of a vehicle's two axles, the new track before the old one, so a section both tracks belong to never reads empty (TTrack::AxleCounter(), TrkFoll.cpp:88-91). The track's isolated sections count it.

method.name: track_axle_left
method.description: Reports that an axle of [param vehicle] left the track.

method.name: track_create
method.description: Creates an empty track. Give it curves with [method track_update_curves] and a type with [method track_update].

method.name: track_exists
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param track] is a track of this server.

method.name: track_free
method.description: Frees the track, its switch first ([signal switch_freed]), and removes it from its isolated sections and the topology.

method.name: track_get_blade_boundary_offset
method.description: Returns how far along [param branch] [m] the switch blade reaches, measured from the common end (Track.cpp:1371 bladelength).

method.name: track_get_branch_end_endpoint
method.description: Returns the endpoint at the end of [param branch] of a two-curve track.

method.name: track_get_branch_neighbors
method.description: Returns the tracks connected to the start and to the end of [param branch], where each end has exactly one connection.

method.name: track_get_branch_start_endpoint
method.description: Returns the endpoint at the start of [param branch] of a two-curve track.

method.name: track_get_common_endpoint_index
method.description: Returns which end of the first curve the two curves of a switch track share, [constant POINT_NONE] when they share none.

method.name: track_get_common_endpoints
method.description: Returns the [enum EndpointIndex] values of the endpoints the two curves share.

method.name: track_get_curve
method.description: Returns the curve resource of [param branch]; the first curve where the track has no second one.

method.name: track_get_damage_flag
method.description: The damage to [param track] a vehicle on it takes notice of ([code]TTrack::iDamageFlag[/code], [code]Track.cpp:452-458[/code]).

method.name: track_get_domain_curve
method.description: Returns the baked [Curve3D] of [param branch] the vehicles follow, its ends lifted by the curve's roll (Segment.cpp:84).

method.name: track_get_endpoint_branch
method.description: Returns the branch the endpoint belongs to.

method.name: track_get_endpoint_connections
method.description: Returns the endpoints of other tracks that meet [param track] at [param endpoint_index].

method.name: track_get_endpoints
method.description: Returns the endpoints of the track's curves, in [enum EndpointIndex] order.

method.name: track_get_environment
method.description: Returns what surrounds the track, for its running sounds.

method.name: track_get_friction
method.description: The friction of [param track], as its memory cell modifies it ([code]TTrack::Friction()[/code], [code]Track.cpp:2527-2533[/code]) - see [method track_set_friction_modifier].

method.name: track_get_group
method.description: What runs on [param track] - rails, a road, water ([code]TTrack::iCategoryFlag[/code], [code]Track.cpp:396-432[/code]).

method.name: track_get_length
method.description: Returns the length [m] of [param branch] of a switch track, the first curve's length for any other track.

method.name: track_get_name
method.description: Returns the track's own name, also when another track took the lookup by it over.

method.name: track_get_next
method.description: Returns the endpoint of the track a movement leaving [param track] at [param endpoint_index] continues onto, following the switches as they are set; [code]null[/code] at an open or ambiguous node.

method.name: track_get_quality_flag
method.description: Returns the track's quality flag (TTrack::iQualityFlag, Track.cpp:455).

method.name: track_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the track registered under [param name] - the last one given it (basic_table::insert(), Names.h:40-49) - or an invalid RID.

method.name: track_get_rids
method.description: Returns all tracks.

method.name: track_get_roll
method.description: The roll of the branch's curve at its start (x) and its end (y), in degrees, as read out of the curve resource when it was set.

method.name: track_get_sound_distance
method.description: Returns the rail length between joints [m] for the wheel clatter, negative for none.

method.name: track_get_switch
method.description: Returns the switch of a [constant TRACK_SWITCH] track, an invalid RID for any other.

method.name: track_get_vehicles
method.description: Returns the vehicles standing on the track, as [RailVehicleServer] reports them.

method.name: track_get_velocity
method.description: Returns the track's speed limit [km/h], negative for none.

method.name: track_get_width
method.description: Returns the track's gauge [m].

method.name: track_is_occupied
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a vehicle is listed on the track - one whose primary axle is on it (TTrack::Dynamics).

method.name: track_is_switch
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for a [constant TRACK_SWITCH] track.

method.name: track_is_switch_right
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the diverging branch of the switch track turns right, seen from the common end.

method.name: track_set_damage_flag
method.description: A derailer worked: the damage a scenario's switch event leaves on a plain track ([code]TTrack::Switch()[/code], [code]Track.cpp:1846-1847[/code]).

method.name: track_set_friction_modifier
method.description: From now on the friction of [param track] is its own times [param multiplier] plus [param offset], clamped to 0-1 - what the scenery's [code]friction <memcell>[/code] of a track makes of the cell's two values ([code]Track.cpp:2527-2533[/code]).

method.name: track_set_velocity
method.description: Sets the track's speed limit [km/h], negative for none (TTrack::VelocitySet(), a [code]trackvel[/code] event).

method.name: track_trace_route
method.description: Returns the tracks a movement goes over from [param track] on [param branch], toward its end or its start, entered [param start] [m] from where the distance is measured, until [param distance] [m]. The first segment is [param track] itself, the last is marked [code]line_end[/code] when nothing follows it; a switch entered from its common end follows its setting ([code]branch_from_setting[/code]).

method.name: track_update
method.description: Sets the track's type, name and gauge [m]. Becoming [constant TRACK_SWITCH] creates the track's switch ([signal switch_created]), leaving it frees the switch ([signal switch_freed]). A name already taken moves to this track; an empty name takes the track's name away.

method.name: track_update_curves
method.description: Sets the track's curves ([code]TrackCurve[/code] resources), the second one for a switch's diverging branch, and computes its lengths and switch geometry.

method.name: track_update_properties
method.description: Sets what the running sounds read of the track (Track.cpp:449).

method.name: track_vehicle_entered
method.description: Lists [param vehicle] on the track: its primary axle came onto it - called by [RailVehicleServer] (TTrack::AddDynamicObject(), TrkFoll.cpp:194-241). What [method track_is_occupied] and [method track_get_vehicles] answer; the isolated sections count axles instead ([method track_axle_entered]).

method.name: track_vehicle_left
method.description: Takes [param vehicle] off the track's list: its primary axle left it.

method.name: tracks_find_in_aabb
method.description: Returns the tracks whose extent intersects [param aabb], given on the XZ plane.

members.member: [code]true[/code] from a change of the topology until the next [method topology_rebuild].
The rail height [m] the tracks are sampled with (Track.cpp:555).
The largest switch blade offset [m] (Track.cpp:33 fMaxOffset).
The blade travel [m] before a switch's blades start moving (Track.h:68 fOffsetDelay).

signal.name: isolated_axle_entered
signal.description: An axle of [param vehicle] came onto the isolated section ([code]:inc[/code]) - twice for every vehicle, as it has two axles.

signal.name: isolated_axle_left
signal.description: An axle of [param vehicle] left the isolated section ([code]:dec[/code]).

signal.name: isolated_freed
signal.description: The last axle left the isolated section ([code]:free[/code]); [param vehicle] is that axle's.

signal.name: isolated_occupied
signal.description: The first axle came onto the isolated section ([code]:busy[/code]); [param vehicle] is that axle's.

signal.name: switch_active_track_changed
signal.description: The switch was set to another branch; its blades start moving.

signal.name: switch_created
signal.description: A track became a [constant TRACK_SWITCH] track and got this switch.

signal.name: switch_freed
signal.description: The switch track became another type or was freed; [param name] is the name its track had.

signal.name: switch_movement_finished
signal.description: The switch's blades came to lie on [param active_track].

signal.name: switch_movement_started
signal.description: The switch's blades start moving from [param from_track] to [param to_track].

signal.name: switch_offset_changed
signal.description: The switch's blades moved; read the offsets with [method switch_get_f_offset1] and [method switch_get_f_offset2].

signal.name: topology_changed
signal.description: A track was created or freed, or a connected endpoint moved; [method topology_rebuild] is due.

signal.name: tracks_changed
signal.description: A track was created, updated or freed.
